data.one_liner: Meilisearch API client for Dart and Flutter developers
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client to interact with the Meilisearch search engine, allowing you to add documents, perform typo-tolerant searches, manage indexes, and configure search parameters.
use_when: You need to integrate Meilisearch search functionality into your Dart or Flutter application.
You want fast, typo-tolerant search capabilities backed by a Meilisearch instance.
avoid_when: You are using a different backend search provider like Algolia or Elasticsearch.
You require an entirely on-device embedded search engine without an external server.
strengths: Typo-tolerant search out of the box
Supports customizable dio instances for network requests
weaknesses: Requires a running Meilisearch server or Meilisearch Cloud instance
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the MeiliSearchClient with a server URL and master key.
